pages.text: The $(bold)consumer$() of Exhausted Crystals: the Item Reconstructor transmutes items into rarities in exchange for crystals - the endpoint of the $(bold)waste economy$().$(br)Each crystal costs $(bold)50 Akaishi Energy$() and processes $(bold)1 crystal/tick$(); switching the input resets progress and a full output pauses the machine.

$(bold)Recipe samples (crystal cost in brackets):$()$(li)Amethyst Shard ×8 -> Echo Shard$(li)Quartz ×16 -> Prismarine Shard$(li)Leather ×16 -> Phantom Membrane$(li)Golden Apple ×16 -> Enchanted Golden Apple$(li)Snowball ×32 -> Ghast Tear$(li)Skeleton Skull ×32 -> Wither Skeleton Skull$(li)Wither Skeleton Skull ×32 -> Nether Star$(br2)$(bold)Note:$() 11 recipes in total; see the JEI "Item Reconstruct" category for the full list. Higher cost, rarer result.
